parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const loc = $json.location; let location = null; if (loc && typeof loc === 'object') location = loc.name || null; else if (typeof loc === 'string') { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(loc); location = (parsed && parsed.name) ? parsed.name : loc; } catch (e) { location = loc; } } return JSON.stringify({ source: $json.source, source_job_id: String($json.source_job_id), company: $json.company, title: $json.title, description: $json.description || null, url: $json.url, location, published_at: $json.published_at || null }); })() }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const pub = $json.published_at; if (!pub) return true; const t = new Date(pub).getTime(); if (Number.isNaN(t)) return true; return (Date.now() - t) <= (60 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); })() }}
